# ARAVANA LAW

ARAVANA LAW is a plaintiff-side personal injury law firm founded by attorney Ara Naljian, with offices in New York, NY and Rochelle Park, NJ, representing injured people in both states on a contingency-fee basis (No Win, No Fee).

- Website: https://aravanalaw.com
- Phone: (347) 456-8567
- Email: ara@aravanalaw.com
- Attorney: Ara V. Naljian, Esq., Founder & Managing Attorney, licensed in New York and New Jersey

## Offices

- New York: Naljian Law Firm PLLC d/b/a ARAVANA LAW, 11 Park Place, 3rd Floor, New York, NY 10007
- New Jersey: Naljian Law Firm LLC d/b/a ARAVANA LAW, 174 Route 17 North, Suite 201, Rochelle Park, NJ 07662
